title: Notes
tagline: Read, revise, understand — then test yourself. Math, figures and live simulations in one place.

subjects.title: Density Functional Theory
subjects.description: From the many-electron Schrödinger equation to Kohn–Sham, exchange–correlation functionals, plane-wave practice and machine-learned potentials — written to the depth expected in research-engineer interviews at AI-for-science teams.
subjects.intro: Each chapter ends with a quiz. Chapters **11** (question bank) and **12** (final exam) are for interview preparation. Interactive figures run real calculations in your browser — play with them.

chapters.title: Roadmap & one-page cheat sheet
chapters.description: What DFT is, why it matters, how to use these notes, and the equations you must know cold.

chapters.title: The many-electron problem
chapters.description: Born–Oppenheimer, the exponential wall, Hartree and Hartree–Fock, exchange vs correlation.

chapters.title: Hohenberg–Kohn theorems
chapters.description: Why the density is enough: proofs, the variational principle, Levy–Lieb constrained search, Thomas–Fermi.

chapters.title: Kohn–Sham equations
chapters.description: The non-interacting reference system, derivation, total energy, meaning of eigenvalues, the SCF loop (with a live solver).

chapters.title: Exchange–correlation functionals
chapters.description: xc holes, adiabatic connection, LDA → GGA → meta-GGA → hybrids → double hybrids, dispersion, exact constraints.

chapters.title: Where DFT fails — and the fixes
chapters.description: Self-interaction, delocalization error, the band-gap problem, strong correlation, DFT+U, dispersion.

chapters.title: DFT in practice
chapters.description: Bloch's theorem, k-points, basis sets, pseudopotentials & PAW, smearing, SCF mixing, convergence and codes.

chapters.title: Forces, dynamics & beyond the ground state
chapters.description: Hellmann–Feynman and Pulay forces, relaxations, phonons/DFPT, AIMD, spin, TDDFT, GW, finite temperature.

chapters.title: Machine learning × DFT
chapters.description: ML interatomic potentials, equivariant GNNs, universal models, datasets, learned functionals, generative materials design.

chapters.title: Hands-on: write a Kohn–Sham solver
chapters.description: A complete 1D DFT code in NumPy, then real calculations with PySCF and ASE + Quantum ESPRESSO.

chapters.title: History & progress
chapters.description: A century of ideas: Thomas–Fermi to foundation models for atoms.

chapters.title: Interview question bank
chapters.description: ~60 questions with model answers: fundamentals, practice, ML, coding and system design.

chapters.title: Final exam & flashcards
chapters.description: A mixed test across all chapters plus a flashcard deck for spaced revision.

subjects.title: Mathematical Physics
subjects.description: Multivariable calculus for physicists: gradients, Jacobians, Hessians, stability and the road to coupled oscillations.

chapters.title: Multivariable calculus for coupled oscillators
chapters.description: Partial derivatives, chain rule, gradient, Jacobians, Taylor expansion, Hessian and linearisation.
